tool_input.command: for g in feature-online-stores feature-groups feature-views featurestores; do echo "=== $g ==="; gcloud ai $g --help 2>&1 | head -4; done

echo "=== dataset ==="; bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT ls -d --format=prettyjson $GCP_PROJECT:$GCP_BQ_DATASET 2>&1 | head -20; echo "=== tables in dataset ==="; bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT ls $GCP_BQ_DATASET 2>&1 | head

echo "location try:"; bq --location=$GCP_LOCATION --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT show --format=prettyjson $GCP_PROJECT:$GCP_BQ_DATASET 2>&1 | grep -iE "location|id|datasetRef" | head; echo "=== ls ==="; bq --location=$GCP_LOCATION --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT ls --datasets 2>&1 | head

set -e
DS=$GCP_BQ_DATASET
LOC=$GCP_LOCATION
bq --location=$LOC --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT load --replace --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 \
  ${DS}.stg_transactions ./data/transactions.csv \
  row_id:STRING,account_id:STRING,event_time:INT64,amount:FLOAT64,currency:STRING
echo "transactions loaded"
bq --location=$LOC --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT load --replace --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 \
  ${DS}.stg_fx_rates ./data/fx_rates.csv \
  currency:STRING,fx_rate:FLOAT64
echo "fx loaded"
tool_input.description: Load CSVs into BQ staging tables

tool_input.command:
set -e
DS=$GCP_BQ_DATASET
LOC=$GCP_LOCATION
bq --location=$LOC --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT query --use_legacy_sql=false --replace --destination_table=${DS}.features347afc \
"SELECT
   t.row_id,
   t.account_id,
   t.event_time,
   ROUND(t.amount * f.fx_rate, 10) AS amount_usd,
   IF(EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(t.event_time)) IN (1,7), 1, 0) AS is_weekend,
   (SELECT SUM(t2.amount)
      FROM \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${DS}.stg_transactions\` t2
     WHERE t2.account_id = t.account_id
       AND t2.event_time BETWEEN t.event_time - 604800000 AND t.event_time
   ) AS amount_7d
 FROM \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${DS}.stg_transactions\` t
 JOIN \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${DS}.stg_fx_rates\` f USING (currency)"
echo "=== feature table created ==="
bq --location=$LOC --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT query --use_legacy_sql=false \
"SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNTIF(amount_usd IS NULL) usd_null, COUNTIF(amount_7d IS NULL) w_null, SUM(is_weekend) weekends FROM \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${DS}.features347afc\`"
